name: Contract Change
description: Modify API boundary, type export, function signature, event shape, or interface.

default_promises.description: Consumer verification passes for all affected consumers
Breaking changes documented with migration path
Backward compatibility maintained or version negotiated
All callers updated to match new contract

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-CONTRACT01
  TYPE: CONTRACT:RESPONSE
  SCOPE: src/api/endpoint.ts
  MODULES: api
  RISK CAP: HIGH
  PROMISES:
    1. Consumer tests pass → verify: contract_test
    2. Migration path documented → verify: diff_inspection
    3. All callers updated → verify: test_passes
  STATUS: proposed
